name: Myotismon (X Antibody)
main_effect:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon.
[On Deletion] If [Myotismon] or [X Antibody] was in this Digimon's digivolution cards, you may play 1 level 6 Digimon card with [Myotismon] in its name from your trash without paying the cost.
set_name: LM-04: Limited Card Pack Torrid Weiss
